info.title: OSY Operations API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API for managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), companies, employees, and operational logs with automated text extraction and AI-powered analysis via Google Gemini. SOPs are modeled as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where steps are nodes and edges define execution dependencies.

RoleTitle.description: Comprehensive role title enumeration covering corporate and healthcare organizations. Roles are organized by Pillar (EXECUTIVE_LEADERSHIP, ENGINEERING, PRODUCT, DESIGN, SALES, HUMAN_RESOURCES, OPERATIONS, CUSTOMER_SUCCESS, HEALTHCARE_CLINICAL, HEALTHCARE_OFFICE, CROSS_FUNCTIONAL) with clear IC and Manager tracks. Use RoleTitle.getPillar() to determine which pillar a role belongs to.
